Test Steps: Open page and verify title
Expected Result: Title is "Java Tutorial" or contains "Java Tutorial | W3Schools"

Test Steps: Open page and verify main heading text
Expected Result: Main heading "Java Tutorial" is visible

Test Steps: Open page and check top navigation menu
Expected Result: Top navigation menu items displayed and clickable

Test Steps: Open page and verify left sidebar content
Expected Result: Left sidebar displays Java tutorial links such as "Home"

Test Steps: Open page and scroll to main content
Expected Result: Main sections like "Java is a programming language"

Test Steps: Click "Try it Yourself" for first Java example
Expected Result: New tab/window opens with Tryit Editor and code loaded

Test Steps: Open page and verify sample code examples are visible
Expected Result: Sample code blocks are displayed and formatted correctly
Notes: Check at least one code block appears

Test Steps: Click a Java tutorial subsection link from the left sidebar
Expected Result: Page navigates to the correct subsection without error

Test Steps: Open page and verify search input box appears
Expected Result: Search box is visible and can accept text

Test Steps: Type "Java string" in search and submit
Expected Result: Search results or suggestions relevant to Java string topic appear

Test Steps: Scroll to footer and click "About W3Schools"
Expected Result: Footer link opens correct page
Notes: Repeat for "Contact" or "Privacy" links if available

Test Steps: Resize browser to mobile width and reload page
Expected Result: Page content reflows and navigation adapts for mobile

Test Steps: Scan all visible tutorial links on page
Expected Result: No broken links; all link URLs return HTTP 200
Notes: Focus on left menu and main examples

Test Steps: Open page in Chrome and Firefox
Expected Result: Page renders without critical layout or script errors

Test Steps: Verify any tutorial images load correctly
Expected Result: All images on page display with no broken image icon

Test Steps: Verify page mentions Java version or features
Expected Result: Relevant Java version/feature information is present in content

Test Steps: Inspect page for alt text on images and visible labels
Expected Result: Images have alt text and controls have accessible labels

Test Steps: Scroll to bottom of page
Expected Result: Page scrolls smoothly and no content is cut off

Test Steps: Open page and verify cookie/privacy notice behavior
Expected Result: If notice appears it can be accepted or dismissed and does not obstruct content

Test Steps: Click "Java Home" from left menu
Expected Result: Page navigates to Java homepage section or refreshed home content

Test Steps: Click a code example link or section from the page
Expected Result: Page navigates to correct example or section anchor

Test Steps: If language switcher exists
Expected Result: select another language or region
Priority: Page loads localized content or language options are available

Test Steps: Inspect page source for meta description and OG tags
Expected Result: Meta tags exist and describe Java tutorial content

Test Steps: Measure page load time under normal conditions
Expected Result: Page loads within acceptable threshold (e.g. < 5s)

Test Steps: Accept cookies if notice appears
Expected Result: Notice closes and content remains accessible

Test Steps: Verify common Java tutorial text is present
Expected Result: Java is a programming language text is present

Expected Result: Tryit Editor opens and code can be edited
